biocontainers.name: bioconductor-erssa
biocontainers.license: GPL-3 | GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE Version 3

biotools.summary: The ERSSA package takes user supplied RNA-seq differential expression dataset and calculates the number of differentially expressed genes at varying biological replicate levels. This allows the user to determine, without relying on any a priori assumptions, whether sufficient differential detection has been acheived with their RNA-seq dataset.
